subject: Add approvals table via Alembic migration
description:
Write a new Alembic migration `migrations/00X_approvals.py` creating the `approvals` table per §5.8 and §7.3 plus index `idx_approvals_pending`.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] Migration creates `approvals` table with columns: `approval_id TEXT PK`, `user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users`, `thread_id TEXT NOT NULL`, `action_kind TEXT NOT NULL`, `action_payload_json TEXT NOT NULL`, `status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending','approved','denied','expired'))`, `created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP`, `resolved_at TIMESTAMP`, `choice TEXT`, `reason TEXT`.
- [ ] Creates `CREATE INDEX idx_approvals_pending ON approvals(status) WHERE status='pending'`.
- [ ] Migration runs cleanly forward and (if reversible) backward.
- [ ] No FK from `approvals` to `delegations` (per §5.8: linked through `action_payload_json` only).

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Migration applied on a database that already has the table (re-running): no-op.

**Testing Requirements:**
• Integration: `alembic upgrade head` adds the table with all columns and the partial index
• Integration: insert with invalid `status` rejected by check constraint

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 5.8, 7.3, 9.4
